description: This file defines internal implementation details for an inlined vector container in the Abseil C++ library, including templates for storage management, iterators, and policies for efficient memory operations.

classes.name: Storage
classes.description: Template class managing storage for an inlined vector, including inline and heap storage, with methods for initialization, assignment, resizing, insertion, erasure, reservation, shrinking, and swapping.

classes.name: IteratorValueAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for iterating over elements via an iterator, providing methods to construct or assign the next element.

classes.name: CopyValueAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for copying a value from a pointer, used for constructing or assigning elements.

classes.name: AllocationTransaction
classes.description: Transactional class for managing memory allocation and deallocation during vector operations.

classes.name: ConstructionTransaction
classes.description: Transactional class for managing element construction and destruction during vector resizing and copying.

methods.name: DestroyContents
methods.description: Destroys all elements and deallocates storage if allocated.

methods.name: InitFrom
methods.description: Initializes storage from another storage instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Constructs elements with given values and size.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns new elements, resizing as necessary.

methods.name: Resize
methods.description: Resizes the storage, constructing or destroying elements as needed.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts elements at a specified position.

methods.name: EmplaceBack
methods.description: Constructs and adds a new element at the end.

methods.name: EmplaceBackSlow
methods.description: Slow path for EmplaceBack when reallocation is needed.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves capacity for a specified number of elements.

methods.name: ShrinkToFit
methods.description: Reduces capacity to fit the current size.

methods.name: Swap
methods.description: Swaps contents with another storage instance.
